04 — The Artist
SHORT
LORD
Artist · Producer · CEO · Chosenfewrecords

Roots in French Guiana (Guyane), with Caribbean lineage also traced to Martinique and St. Lucia. US-American on his father's side — Chicago. Raised beside the army base in Hessen. Shortlord was the one who brought Class Productions and Phantom Black to Boogiepark in the late 90s, building one of Hamburg's first real hip-hop hotspots. Farhot produced "Ways of Mankind" on Heavensent before going on to Haftbefehl, Talib Kweli, Nas, and Isaiah Rashad on TDE. Gold record at 18. Bundesliga campaign 2022. Chosenfewrecords since 2006. Now back in full effect.

07 — The Label
TWENTY
YEARS.
HAMBURG.
INDEPENDENT.

Shortlord was the one who brought Class Productions and Phantom Black to Boogiepark in the late 90s, turning it into one of Hamburg's first real hip-hop hotspots. Class Productions produced KC da Rookee and the Harlekings. Four years after Class left, Sleepwalker took over their studio and made Samy Deluxe's "Weck mich auf" from it — #4 Germany, Gold record, 2001. In the same underground, DJ Farhot was building his sound. Chosenfewrecords, since 2006. Always independent.

Official Recognition
Listed in Hamburg's Labelförderung Förderergebnisse — Behörde für Kultur und Medien (Hamburg Ministry of Culture & Media)
⚽ Bundesliga Campaign — Jan 2022
Shortlord's rap featured in the official DFL Bundesliga Instagram campaign "#YouAreTheBundesliga" — 6,500+ likes on the verified @bundesliga account. 180M+ Bundesliga fans reached. → Watch the Clip
